headline: C-A(a) is REFUTED on its stated domain by a fully verified n=6 exact-domain instance; replaced by the sharper conjecture C-B

counterexample.why_it_refutes: W={4} is not a richer suffix: players 2,5 are strictly richer and do not move. Also not W=H∩S ({2,4,5}∩S={2,4,5}).
counterexample.class: BT - the top stratum {2,5} is phi-TIGHT, the first such base game ever sampled; Theorem A bars a tight suffix from paying, so the loss drops one stratum
hypotheses_all_satisfied: v' differs from v at S only
verified_three_ways: independent Sigma_m-ladder leximin + z3 UNSAT uniqueness proof
full exact-rational exactness certification of all 62 proper coalitions of both games, plus independent exact_lp

corrected_invariant.name: C-B
corrected_invariant.statement: with strata B_1<...<B_k and suffixes H_j = B_{j+1} u ... u B_k, let j* = max{j : H_j slack}; then W = B_{j*+1}, a SINGLE payoff stratum - the highest stratum whose upward suffix is still slack
corrected_invariant.recovers_C_A: when B_k is slack, j*=k-1 and W=B_k, which is a suffix - that is why C-A survived 303 violations; every earlier base game had B_k slack
corrected_invariant.evidence: 253/253 exact-domain violations, including all 5 that refute C-A; W is a single payoff stratum in 253/253

reduction_status.SC1_W_eq_Hc_int_S: FALSE - refuted by the counterexample (H_c ∩ S = {2,4,5}, W = {4})
reduction_status.SC2_Hc_subset_S: SURVIVES - holds in the counterexample ({2,4,5} inside {1,2,3,4,5}) and in all 253 exact-domain violations; still open
reduction_status.replacement_for_SC1: Prop D (proved): a phi-tight richer suffix cannot lose in aggregate, so richer members of S are protected by tightness above them, not exposed

new_proved.PropD: if H_j is a phi-tight richer suffix and H_j != S then Delta(H_j) >= 0: a tight suffix cannot lose in aggregate
new_proved.LemmaC: if T is phi'-tight and S is not a subset of T, then Delta(T) <= 0; if T is also phi-tight then Delta(T) = 0
new_proved.TheoremB_minimal_hypothesis: Theorem B's conclusions (d <= g(S); phi_j >= d - s_phi(S) for outsiders; s_phi(N\S) >= rho) need exactness of v' only at coalitions strictly containing S

local_exactness_refuted.question: does exactness of v' at the S-completions suffice for the loser-set law?
local_exactness_refuted.conclusion: exactness of v' at coalitions NOT containing S is doing the work; ce7 fails LE only incidentally; the theorem cannot be localized this way

generator_tuning.finding: at n=6, TWO-row lower envelopes with large common total are far richer in boundary structure
generator_tuning.why_it_mattered: this is what made the decisive BT class reachable

honest_limits: all 5 refuting instances come from ONE base game (five d values spanning the whole window); the refutation is airtight but C-B's discriminating evidence is thin
BT games are 1.1% of sampled games and windows inside them are rare, so the class is expensive to sample
C-B is a conjecture, not a theorem; a constructive BT family (paper4-style, tight top stratum above a slack suffix) is the right next step
paper4_recommendation: still a section, now stronger: proved theorem (Prop 1-3, Theorem A, Theorem B, Prop D) + a verified counterexample retiring the 'losers = slack richer suffix' formulation + conjecture C-B with 253/253 evidence + the remark that exactness of v' is indispensable and cannot be localized. Section thesis: 'monotonicity failure is carried by one payoff stratum, the topmost one that still has slack'.
